## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf` / `test` / `ci` / `build` / `chore`

## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`type(scope): description`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (required for features and fixes)
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm format:check` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test:ci` passes
- [ ] No hardcoded UI strings (uses i18n)
- [ ] No `any` types or `@ts-ignore`
- [ ] UI changes work in Hebrew (RTL) and English (LTR)
- [ ] No personal data or secrets (see ADR 0007)
- [ ] Documentation or ADRs updated when behavior or architecture changed
